tspan.tspan: 始终使用无穷远标称光圈

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 3D 物理相机对焦距离为 u_focus, 焦距为 f, 标称光圈为 N = f / D?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 忽略像距延伸 v = f*1+m · 微距曝光按 1+m ² = 1+u 亏损至 2.0000× 以上!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 由高斯透镜方程计算横向放大率 m = f / max u_focus - f, ε

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 计算有效光圈 N_eff = N * 1 + m 与皮腔补偿因子 B = 1 + m ²

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 将传感器曝光乘以 B 并用 N_eff 计算艾里斑 · 全 17 站恒锁曝光比 1.0000× · 0/17 欠曝 · 提速 23.50×
